name: Parasol - Unexpected Process in parasol-secured
description: Detects execution of a shell, package manager, or network tool inside the Parasol secured agent workloads at runtime. The agent containers should only run their application process; an interactive shell, dnf/microdnf, curl/wget, or a port scanner indicates tampering, a supply-chain issue, or an abused tool call.
rationale: An AI agent workload should never spawn a package manager or ad-hoc network client. Such a process at runtime is a strong signal of compromise or misuse of the agent execution environment.
remediation: Investigate why the process ran in parasol-secured. Rebuild the image without shell/package-manager access, restrict the agent tool permissions, and treat the pod as suspect.
